theme: Goal-based investing: education, retirement, home, wedding funds
headline: Build Your Dreams One Goal at a Time
body: Different life goals need different time horizons. Align your investments with when you'll need the money.
caption: Whether saving for education, a home, retirement, or wedding, matching your investment approach to your goal's timeline helps create a structured path forward. Starting early gives your money more time to grow. #GoalBasedInvesting #FinancialGoals #SmartSavings #InvestmentStrategy #WealthBuilding
